tables.name: meta
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE meta (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT
)

tables.name: topics
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE topics (
  topic_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  format_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  url TEXT NOT NULL,
  starter TEXT,
  started_at TEXT,
  replies INTEGER,
  views INTEGER,
  pages_total INTEGER,
  pages_fetched INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  first_page_fetched INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  last_page_fetched INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  fully_fetched INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  last_post_at TEXT,
  locked INTEGER,
  pinned INTEGER,
  listing_page INTEGER
)

tables.name: formats
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE formats (
  format_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  format_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  category TEXT NOT NULL,          -- random_draw | performance | completion | prediction | jury_vote | first_come | mixed | to_verify | other
  mechanism TEXT,                  -- short description of how winners are chosen
  evidence TEXT,                   -- quote from the rules that establishes the mechanism
  evidence_url TEXT,
  decided_by TEXT                  -- 'rules_text' (automatic, quote found) | 'review' (format reviewed by hand)
)

tables.name: editions
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE editions (
  edition_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,     -- 'E<topic_id>'
  topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES topics(topic_id),
  challenge_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  format_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  format_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  category TEXT NOT NULL,
  mechanism TEXT,
  mechanism_evidence TEXT,
  mechanism_evidence_url TEXT,
  classification_basis TEXT,       -- edition_text | format_review | none
  published_at TEXT,
  start_date TEXT,
  end_date TEXT,
  results_date TEXT,
  year INTEGER,
  period_label TEXT,
  rules_excerpt TEXT,
  eligibility TEXT,
  prize_pool_amount REAL,
  prize_pool_currency TEXT,
  prize_pool_source TEXT,
  winners_announced INTEGER,       -- "Congrats to the N winners"
  winners_listed INTEGER,          -- winners whose name we extracted
  participants_known INTEGER,      -- distinct eligible posters counted on fully fetched topics
  participants_basis TEXT,
  entries_known INTEGER,
  draw_method TEXT,
  results_comment_id INTEGER,
  results_url TEXT,
  external_urls TEXT,              -- JSON array
  results_status TEXT,             -- names_published | names_external | names_partial | names_not_published | no_results_found | not_collected
  reliability TEXT,                -- high | medium | low
  notes TEXT
)

tables.name: awards
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE awards (
  award_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  edition_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES editions(edition_id),
  member TEXT NOT NULL,            -- exactly as written in the source
  member_key TEXT NOT NULL,        -- lower-case grouping key (usernames are case-insensitive)
  identity_type TEXT NOT NULL,     -- results_post | external_list (where the name was published)
  member_id INTEGER,               -- forum profile id when the source links to the profile
  rank INTEGER,
  score TEXT,                      -- multiplier / points / odds as published
  prize_amount REAL,
  prize_currency TEXT,
  prize_usd REAL,                  -- confirmed: USD amount published next to the winner's name
  prize_usd_partial REAL,          -- partially documented: USD amount read from the official prize table for that rank
  prize_usd_est REAL,              -- estimated: conversion of a non-USD amount (see fx_rates); never mixed with the above
  prize_kind TEXT,                 -- cash | bonus | coupon | points | unknown
  prize_basis TEXT,                -- published (amount next to the name) | schedule (amount from the rules' prize table for that rank) | unknown
  category TEXT NOT NULL,
  results_date TEXT,
  source_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_comment_id INTEGER,
  source_kind TEXT NOT NULL,       -- forum_post | pastebin | external
  evidence TEXT,
  verification TEXT NOT NULL,      -- confirmed_official | confirmed_external | probable | estimated | unknown | contradictory
  collected_at TEXT
)

tables.name: award_sources
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE award_sources (
  award_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES awards(award_id),
  source_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  member_as_written TEXT,
  evidence TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (award_id, source_url)
)

tables.name: participants
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE participants (
  edition_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES editions(edition_id),
  member TEXT NOT NULL,
  member_id INTEGER,
  posts INTEGER NOT NULL,
  first_comment_id INTEGER,
  first_posted_at TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (edition_id, member)
)

tables.name: member_links
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE member_links (
  a TEXT NOT NULL,
  a_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  b TEXT NOT NULL,
  b_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  evidence TEXT,
  edition_id TEXT,
  confidence TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (a, b, edition_id)
)

tables.name: anomalies
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE anomalies (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  edition_id TEXT,
  member TEXT,
  details TEXT,
  source_url TEXT
)

tables.name: missing_data
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE missing_data (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  edition_id TEXT,
  field TEXT NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT
)

tables.name: sources
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE sources (
  url TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,              -- board_page | topic_page | pastebin | claim_link | image | other
  topic_id INTEGER,
  status TEXT,                     -- fetched | not_fetched | inaccessible | not_public
  fetched_at TEXT,
  note TEXT
)

tables.name: fx_rates
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE fx_rates (
  currency TEXT NOT NULL,
  month TEXT NOT NULL,             -- YYYY-MM
  usd REAL NOT NULL,               -- value of 1 unit in USD (monthly average)
  source TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (currency, month)
)

tables.name: collection_log
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE collection_log (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  t TEXT,
  key TEXT,
  url TEXT,
  status INTEGER,
  ok INTEGER,
  source TEXT
)

tables.name: imports
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE imports (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  imported_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  file TEXT,
  editions_added INTEGER,
  awards_added INTEGER,
  awards_skipped_duplicates INTEGER
)
